creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-04 a Claude Code pane resumes after a daemon restart with its flags ([session] resume, detection engine 12). Codex (codex resume is a subcommand; where flags go is unrecorded) and OpenCode have no resume spelling, so their panes come back as shells. Record each resuming with flags, then add the manifest tables.
title: Resume spellings for Codex and OpenCode
